correctness.rationale: Proved via: cyclic group of units modulo 3^n giving exactly three cube roots of each ±1 mod9 unit; exhaustive residue classifications; opposite-unit parameter y=-x+3t and H_x(t)=t(x²−3xt+3t²), with H mod3 bijective and derivative x² nonzero; 3 lifts per target modulo 3^(n−2); nonunit scaling contributes 81 times N_(n−3). Base n=0,1,2 handled independently. Exact convolution verifier checks all 9840 target residues at n=1..8, not used as universal proof.

originality.rationale: The exact target-one formula appears explicitly as a July 2018 conjecture in OEIS A087412. Earlier OEIS A087786 already covers zero targets, which are attributed and not claimed separately. Cohen 1955 p≡1 (mod3), Finch–Sebah single-cube counts and Monsky rational equation do not state the ramified all-target counting rule. Actual mathematical search and history found no equivalent formula; the proof is elementary so an implicit or uncatalogued overlap is a material residual risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed 3-adic local-density work might contain an equivalent statement under different normalization.
Given elementary lifting, the full rule may be implicit in stronger earlier results not detected by literature comparison.
The numerical sequence dates to October 2003, while the specific cited power-of-three conjecture first appears as a dated July 2018 formula note.

value.rationale: Determines the full representation-count distribution and exact local solubility for sums of two cubes modulo all powers of ramified prime three, including singular valuation recursion. It settles an explicitly stated July 2018 3-power conjecture on a natural counting sequence. The zero-target formula is prior, but the full vector of target counts is a motivated natural arithmetic invariant, not an arbitrary slice or isolated finite check.
